comments.text:
Code review for `2eb2f2d..53dd87d`:

Assessment: Ready to merge

Critical:
- none

Important:
- Tests landed in `packages/core/test/persistence.test.ts` (appended) rather than the new `packages/core/test/persistence/schema.test.ts` the plan prescribed. Functionally correct and all tests pass; recommend a follow-up task to migrate schema tests to the subdirectory when the `persistence/` test folder is created for task 2+.

Minor:
- No enforcement test for the partial unique index (two open arcs should throw). Existence-only check matches the plan's prescribed test bodies; add enforcement as a follow-up.
- Cosmetic: `campaign_arc` DDL uses padded column-name alignment inconsistent with adjacent tables.

Follow-up:
- Create a task to extract schema tests into `packages/core/test/persistence/schema.test.ts` when the persistence test subdirectory is introduced.
- Consider an enforcement test for `campaign_arc_one_open` (insert two open arcs, assert UNIQUE constraint failure).
